---
title: "Offensive linemen are drafted most often and quarterbacks earliest"
date: "2026-10-24"
description: "Offensive linemen with a stat line are drafted most often (8.4% of eligible seasons), quarterbacks sit mid-table yet lead round 1 (26.2% of drafted quarterback seasons), and quarterbacks and offensive linemen are the only groups whose NFL entrants mostly arrive drafted."
followups:
  - "Carry position as a feature in the models; the sixfold spread in drafted rates and the round mix are variance a pooled model would otherwise spend capacity on."
  - "Treat offensive line as a thin-data category: its rate describes only linemen who left a stat line, not linemen generally."

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)

set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# Wilson interval for a binomial proportion.
wilson <- function(x, n, z = 1.96) {
  p <- x / n
  d <- 1 + z^2 / n
  c <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / d
  h <- (z / d) * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))
  c(lo = pmax(0, c - h), hi = pmin(1, c + h))
}
```

## 1. Introduction

The previous post measured how often eligible college seasons end in an NFL
outcome across all players at once, and since the draft sorts players by
position first, this post splits those seasons by position and tests four
expectations a fan might bring.

+ *Expecting quarterbacks to be the most draftable position.*
+ *Expecting first-round picks to concentrate among quarterbacks.*
+ *Expecting quarterbacks to be picked earliest on average, in every draft
  class.*
+ *Expecting quarterbacks to arrive through the draft while other positions
  lean on the undrafted route.*

## 2. Data

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-24. Draft classes
after the last complete draft are right-censored and carry no outcomes, so
they are excluded from every rate below rather than counted as failures.
Each season's position comes from the roster table, joined by athlete id
and season.*
:::

```{r}
#| label: load
#| include: false
outcomes <- tbl(con, "outcomes") |> collect()
roster_pos <- tbl(con, "roster") |>
  # A few players carry two roster rows in one season (mid-season moves);
  # they always agree on the position, so one row per player-season is kept.
  select(playerId, season, position) |>
  distinct() |>
  collect()
dbDisconnect(con)

risk <- outcomes |>
  filter(draft_eligible, outcome_observed_d) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(outcome_drafted_d, outcome_signed_udfa_d, outcome_nfl_entry_d),
      ~ coalesce(.x, FALSE)
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(roster_pos, by = c("playerId", "season"))

pos_group <- c(
  QB = "Quarterback",
  RB = "Running back",
  FB = "Running back",
  WR = "Receiver",
  TE = "Tight end",
  T = "Offensive line",
  G = "Offensive line",
  C = "Offensive line",
  OL = "Offensive line",
  OT = "Offensive line",
  DL = "Defensive line",
  DE = "Defensive line",
  DT = "Defensive line",
  NT = "Defensive line",
  EDGE = "Defensive line",
  LB = "Linebacker",
  ILB = "Linebacker",
  OLB = "Linebacker",
  DB = "Defensive back",
  S = "Defensive back",
  CB = "Defensive back",
  PK = "Special teams",
  P = "Special teams",
  LS = "Special teams",
  PR = "Special teams"
)
n_risk_pre <- nrow(risk)
risk <- risk |>
  mutate(
    group = dplyr::coalesce(
      dplyr::recode(position, !!!pos_group, .default = "Position not recorded"),
      "Position not recorded"
    )
  )

n_risk <- nrow(risk)
n_players <- n_distinct(risk$playerId)
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
#| include: false
# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
comparable <- function(df) filter(df, group != "Position not recorded")
```

### 2.1 Nine position groups stand in for two dozen roster codes

Each season is counted at the roster position listed for it, and the table
groups roster codes describing the same role into nine groups, plus a tenth
for seasons with none recorded.

```{r}
#| label: group-terms
group_terms <- tribble(
  ~Group                  , ~"Roster codes in the group"                                                                                    ,
  "Quarterback"           , "QB"                                                                                                            ,
  "Running back"          , "RB, FB"                                                                                                        ,
  "Receiver"              , "WR"                                                                                                            ,
  "Tight end"             , "TE"                                                                                                            ,
  "Offensive line"        , "T, G, C, OL, OT"                                                                                                   ,
  "Defensive line"        , "DL, DE, DT, NT, EDGE"                                                                                          ,
  "Linebacker"            , "LB, ILB, OLB"                                                                                                  ,
  "Defensive back"        , "DB, S, CB"                                                                                                     ,
  "Special teams"         , "PK, P, LS, PR"                                                                                                 ,
  "Position not recorded" , "A placeholder code (?), the catch-all athlete code (ATH), or no roster row for that season at all"
)
kable(group_terms, caption = "The position groups used throughout.")
```

### 2.2 The risk set is every eligible season whose draft outcome is already known

A **player-season** is one college season with a recorded stat line and an
**eligible** season is one whose following draft could have selected the
player; the table counts the `r fmt(n_risk)` eligible seasons, from
`r fmt(n_players)` players, behind every rate below.

```{r}
#| label: risk-set
risk_set <- tibble(
  Measure = c("Eligible player-seasons", "Distinct players"),
  Count = fmt(c(n_risk, n_players))
)
kable(risk_set, caption = "The risk set: eligible seasons with a known outcome.")
```

```{r}
#| label: grain-guard
#| include: false
# The guarded position join adds or drops no rows, and the outcome labels
# stay mutually exclusive after the join.
stopifnot(
  nrow(risk) == n_risk_pre,
  !any(is.na(risk$group)),
  !any(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d),
  all(
    risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d ==
      (risk$outcome_drafted_d | risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d)
  )
)
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 Offensive linemen are drafted most often and quarterbacks sit mid-table

```{r}
#| label: rates
rates <- risk |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    players = n_distinct(playerId),
    drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    drafted = drafted_ev / seasons,
    drafted_lo = 100 * wilson(drafted_ev, seasons)["lo"],
    drafted_hi = 100 * wilson(drafted_ev, seasons)["hi"]
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(desc(drafted))
rates_cmp <- comparable(rates) |>
  mutate(group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group)))
rate_of <- function(g) rates$drafted[rates$group == g]
ol_rate <- rate_of("Offensive line")
qb_rate <- rate_of("Quarterback")
st_rate <- rate_of("Special teams")
qb_rank <- which(rates_cmp$group == "Quarterback")
rate_class <- comparable(risk) |>
  group_by(group, draft_year) |>
  summarise(seasons = n(), drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(drafted = drafted_ev / seasons)
```

*Expecting quarterbacks to be the most draftable position.* ❌

The table and the first figure rank the groups by the share of eligible
seasons ending in a draft pick, each with a 95 percent confidence interval
(the range the true rate plausibly occupies, by Wilson's method): about
`r round(100 * ol_rate)` in every 100 offensive-line seasons against
`r round(100 * qb_rate)` for quarterbacks (rank `r qb_rank` of
`r nrow(rates_cmp)`); the second figure follows each group's rate by draft
class.

```{r}
#| label: rates-table
rates_cmp |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = group,
    `Eligible seasons` = fmt(seasons),
    Drafted = fmt(drafted_ev),
    Rate = pct(drafted),
    `95% CI` = sprintf("%.1f%% to %.1f%%", drafted_lo, drafted_hi)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Share of eligible seasons ending in a draft pick, by position group. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted.")
```

```{r}
#| label: rates-fig
#| fig-height: 6
ol_y <- which(levels(rates_cmp$group_f) == "Offensive line")
qb_y <- which(levels(rates_cmp$group_f) == "Quarterback")
ol_hi <- rates_cmp$drafted_hi[rates_cmp$group == "Offensive line"]
qb_hi <- rates_cmp$drafted_hi[rates_cmp$group == "Quarterback"]
p_rates <- ggplot(rates_cmp, aes(100 * drafted, group_f)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = group %in% c("Offensive line", "Quarterback"),
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %.1f%% drafted (%s of %s eligible seasons; 95%% CI %.1f%% to %.1f%%)",
        group,
        100 * drafted,
        fmt(drafted_ev),
        fmt(seasons),
        drafted_lo,
        drafted_hi
      ),
      data_id = group
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = drafted_lo, xmax = drafted_hi), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = drafted_hi + 0.3,
      label = sprintf(
        "%.1f%% (%s of %s)",
        100 * drafted,
        fmt(drafted_ev),
        fmt(seasons)
      )
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 11,
    y = ol_y - 1.7,
    label = "The top rate covers only the\nlinemen who left a stat line",
    size = 4.2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 12.5,
    y = ol_y - 1.25,
    xend = ol_hi + 0.2,
    yend = ol_y - 0.3,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 10,
    y = qb_y - 1.6,
    label = sprintf(
      "Quarterbacks rank %d of %d:\n%.1f%% of eligible seasons drafted",
      qb_rank,
      nrow(rates_cmp),
      100 * qb_rate
    ),
    size = 4.2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 10.8,
    y = qb_y - 1.1,
    xend = qb_hi + 4,
    yend = qb_y - 0.1,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = 18) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#1B9E77", `FALSE` = "gray65")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "The drafted rate spans more than sixfold across positions",
    subtitle = "Share of eligible player-seasons ending in a draft pick, by position group",
    x = "Eligible seasons drafted",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Whiskers: 95% confidence interval. Labels: drafted seasons of eligible seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_rates, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: rates-guard
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  # The draft event stays rare inside every position group.
  all(rates$drafted < 0.10),
  # The claimed ordering: offensive line on top, special teams at the bottom,
  # quarterbacks mid-pack.
  rates$group[1] == "Offensive line",
  rates_cmp$group[nrow(rates_cmp)] == "Special teams",
  qb_rank == 5L,
  abs(ol_rate - 0.0845) < 0.0005,
  abs(qb_rate - 0.0369) < 0.0005,
  abs(st_rate - 0.0122) < 0.0005,
  ol_rate / st_rate > 6
)
```

### 3.2 Drafted quarterbacks go in the first round more often than any other group

```{r}
#| label: round-mix
round_mix <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_drafted_d) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    drafted_seasons = n(),
    round1 = sum(outcome_draft_round_d == 1L),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(round1_share = round1 / drafted_seasons) |>
  arrange(desc(round1_share))
round_cmp <- comparable(round_mix) |>
  mutate(group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group)))
qb_r1 <- round_mix[round_mix$group == "Quarterback", ]
runner_up <- round_cmp[2, ]
cast_pick <- function(name, col) {
  risk[[col]][risk$player == name & risk$outcome_drafted_d]
}
burrow_pick <- cast_pick("Joe Burrow", "outcome_draft_pick_d")
ward_pick <- cast_pick("Cameron Ward", "outcome_draft_pick_d")
travis_round <- cast_pick("Jordan Travis", "outcome_draft_round_d")
travis_pick <- cast_pick("Jordan Travis", "outcome_draft_pick_d")
```

*Expecting first-round picks to concentrate among quarterbacks.* ✅

The table and the first figure give the share of each group's drafted
seasons that went in round 1, led by quarterbacks at
`r pct(qb_r1$round1_share)` (Joe Burrow and Cameron Ward among them, both
first overall) against `r pct(runner_up$round1_share)` for
`r tolower(runner_up$group)`; the second figure shows every group's full
round mix, where Jordan Travis's round-`r travis_round` selection counts
the same in the drafted rate as Burrow's.

```{r}
#| label: round-table
round_cmp |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = group,
    `Drafted seasons` = drafted_seasons,
    `Round 1` = round1,
    `Round 1 share` = pct(round1_share)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "First-round picks among each group's drafted seasons. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted.")
```

### 3.3 Quarterbacks carry the earliest average pick across classes, but not in most single classes

```{r}
#| label: pick-trend
pick_trend <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_drafted_d, !is.na(outcome_draft_pick_d)) |>
  group_by(group, draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    picks = n(),
    avg_pick = mean(outcome_draft_pick_d),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(picks >= 5) |>
  comparable()
pooled_pick <- mean(risk$outcome_draft_pick_d[
  risk$outcome_drafted_d & !is.na(risk$outcome_draft_pick_d)
])
complete_groups <- pick_trend |>
  count(group) |>
  filter(n == max(n)) |>
  pull(group)
group_means <- pick_trend |>
  filter(group %in% complete_groups) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(m = mean(avg_pick), .groups = "drop")
qb_avg_all <- group_means$m[group_means$group == "Quarterback"]
lowest_per_year <- pick_trend |>
  group_by(draft_year) |>
  slice_min(avg_pick, n = 1) |>
  ungroup()
n_classes <- nrow(lowest_per_year)
n_qb_lowest <- sum(lowest_per_year$group == "Quarterback")
qb_trend <- pick_trend |>
  filter(group == "Quarterback") |>
  mutate(
    lowest = draft_year %in%
      lowest_per_year$draft_year[lowest_per_year$group == "Quarterback"]
  )
```

*Expecting quarterbacks to be picked earliest on average, in every draft
class.* ❌

The table and the first figure trace each group's average overall pick:
over all classes quarterbacks sit at pick `r round(qb_avg_all)`, the
earliest of the `r length(complete_groups)` groups with enough picks in
every class, yet they hold the earliest average in only `r n_qb_lowest` of
`r n_classes` classes; the second figure shows every individual pick behind
those averages.

```{r}
#| label: pick-table
pick_trend |>
  group_by(`Position group` = group) |>
  summarise(
    `Classes with 5 or more picks` = n(),
    `Average pick across classes` = round(mean(avg_pick)),
    `Classes with the earliest average` = sum(
      paste(group, draft_year) %in% paste(lowest_per_year$group, lowest_per_year$draft_year)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(`Average pick across classes`) |>
  kable(caption = "Average overall pick by position group, over the group-class cells with at least five picks.")
```

```{r}
#| label: pick-fig
#| fig-height: 6
p_pick <- ggplot(pick_trend, aes(draft_year, avg_pick)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = pooled_pick, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line_interactive(
    data = filter(pick_trend, group != "Quarterback"),
    aes(group = group, tooltip = group, data_id = group),
    color = "gray75",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_line(data = qb_trend, color = "#D95F02", linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_point_interactive(
```

### 3.4 Quarterbacks and offensive linemen are the only groups whose entrants mostly arrive drafted

```{r}
#| label: udfa-share
udfa_share <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    entrants = n(),
    udfa = sum(outcome_signed_udfa_d),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(share = udfa / entrants) |>
  arrange(desc(share))
udfa_cmp <- comparable(udfa_share) |>
  mutate(
    group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group)),
    route = if_else(share < 0.5, "Mostly drafted", "Mostly undrafted")
  )
udfa_of <- function(g) udfa_share$share[udfa_share$group == g]
qb_udfa <- udfa_of("Quarterback")
ol_udfa <- udfa_of("Offensive line")
st_udfa <- udfa_of("Special teams")
overall_udfa <- mean(risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d[risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d])
```

*Expecting quarterbacks to arrive through the draft while other positions
lean on the undrafted route.* ✅

Among seasons ending in NFL entry, the table and the first figure give the
share arriving as an undrafted free agent (signed after going unpicked):
`r pct(qb_udfa)` for quarterbacks and `r pct(ol_udfa)` for offensive
linemen fall below half, against `r pct(overall_udfa)` overall; the second
figure follows each group's undrafted share by draft class.

```{r}
#| label: udfa-table
udfa_cmp |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = group,
    `NFL entrants` = fmt(entrants),
    Undrafted = fmt(udfa),
    `Undrafted share` = pct(share)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "NFL entrants arriving undrafted, by position group. Seasons with no position recorded are omitted.")
```

## 4. Summary

```{r}
#| label: summary-nums
#| include: false
n_ol_players <- rates$players[rates$group == "Offensive line"]
n_nr <- rates$seasons[rates$group == "Position not recorded"]
nr <- filter(risk, group == "Position not recorded")
nr_placeholder <- sum(nr$position %in% "?" & nr$draft_year <= 2018)
nr_no_row <- sum(is.na(nr$position) & nr$draft_year %in% 2021:2022)
stopifnot(
  n_ol_players == 843L,
  n_nr == 822L,
  # The caveat's description of the not-recorded group.
  (nr_placeholder + nr_no_row) / n_nr > 0.85
)
```

Position sets both the level and the shape of draft outcomes, and two of
the four expectations about quarterbacks hold.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tribble(
  ~Expectation                                       , ~Verdict , ~Evidence                                                                                                                         ,
  "Quarterbacks are the most draftable position"     , "❌"      , sprintf("Offensive line leads at %s; quarterbacks rank %d of %d at %s.", pct(ol_rate), qb_rank, nrow(rates_cmp), pct(qb_rate))    ,
  "First-round picks concentrate among quarterbacks" , "✅"      , sprintf("%s of drafted quarterbacks go in round 1, the most of any group.", pct(qb_r1$round1_share))                                ,
  "Quarterbacks are picked earliest in every class"  , "❌"      , sprintf("Earliest average across classes (pick %d), but earliest in only %d of %d classes.", round(qb_avg_all), n_qb_lowest, n_classes) ,
  "Quarterbacks arrive through the draft"            , "✅"      , sprintf("%s of quarterback entrants were drafted, against %s overall.", pct(1 - qb_udfa), pct(1 - overall_udfa))
) |>
  kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important appearance="minimal"}
**The offensive line rate describes a selected group, not linemen in
general.**

- This population requires a stat line, and linemen rarely appear in one.
- The `r fmt(n_ol_players)` linemen in the risk set recovered a fumble,
  caught a deflection, or otherwise left a statistical trace, and their
  `r pct(ol_rate)` drafted rate describes that minority; models should
  treat the line as a thin-data category.
:::

::: {.callout-important appearance="minimal"}
**Position is a feature the models should carry.**

- Both the level (a more than sixfold spread in drafted rates) and the
  shape (round mix, average pick, entry route) differ by position.
- A single pooled model would spend its capacity explaining variance that
  position names in one column.
:::

Two caveats bound the figures. The not-recorded group holds
`r fmt(n_nr)` seasons, `r pct(n_nr / n_risk)` of the risk set, mostly
placeholder codes in the 2012 to 2018 classes and missing roster rows in
the 2021 and 2022 classes; it is counted in the risk set but left out of
the comparisons. And the eligibility-clock imputation noted in the
previous post applies here: high-school graduation year is imputed for
players without a recruiting record, shifting rows in and out of the risk
set; the shifts are not position-specific, so the between-group
comparisons are sturdier than the absolute levels.
